title: Customer Support Operations Lead
description_plain:
Lead our Tier-2 customer advocacy team, manage Zendesk escalation queues, maintain 95%+ CSAT, and track team SLA performance metrics.

Requirements:
- 4+ years of customer service experience with at least 1 year in a team lead capacity.
- Expert-level Zendesk ticketing workflow configuration and reporting.
- Strong verbal and written customer conflict resolution skills.
